answer: An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The reef counter is kept in trellis and atlas publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3496 identities would post 3463 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
